data.name: Bhavesh
data.gender_notes: Bhavesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhavesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhava', which means 'existence' or 'to be'. In Hindu mythology, Bhavesh is the name of the god of existence and creation. He is the preserver of the universe, responsible for the creation and maintenance of life. The name Bhavesh carries the meaning “God, Creator” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god, creator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
